map.输入气温与露点温度，按Magnus关系反算相对湿度RH，用于气象观测与室内环境评: Enter the air temperature and dew point and back-calculate the relative humidity RH with the Magnus relation, for weather observation and indoor environment assessment.
map.由气温与露点，按 Magnus 关系反算相对湿度。: Back-calculate the relative humidity from the air temperature and dew point using the Magnus relation.
map.由干球与湿球温度（或露点）算相对湿度。: Relative humidity from the dry bulb and wet bulb temperatures (or the dew point).
map.由实际水汽压与饱和水汽压比值算 RH。: RH from the ratio of the actual vapour pressure to the saturation vapour pressure.
map.校准湿度传感器用干湿球法。: Calibrate a humidity sensor with the wet and dry bulb method.
map.：干球 25°C、湿球 19°C、气压 1013 hPa → 查表/公式得 RH: Dry bulb 25°C, wet bulb 19°C and pressure 1013 hPa → the table or formula gives RH≈60%, consistent with the dew point method.
map.湿球和露点哪个准？: Which is more accurate, the wet bulb or the dew point?
map.通风良好时湿球法稳；露点法在低温高湿更准，两者可互校。: With good ventilation the wet bulb method is steady; the dew point method is more accurate at low temperature and high humidity, and the two can cross-check each other.
map.过饱和可达 >100%（雾/云中），地面通常≤100，短暂超饱和称过饱和凝结核不: Supersaturation can exceed 100% (in fog and cloud), while at ground level it is usually ≤100; brief supersaturation means condensation nuclei are insufficient.
